question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The act or process of going from the simple or basic to the complex or advanced.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Evolution"** means the gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form. (विकास)

 
 
• **Example: **The **evolution **of technology has drastically changed our lives over the past few decades.
 
 
 
• **"Evolution" **refers to the process through which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage). (विकास)
 
 
• **Example: **The **evolution** of language is a fascinating subject for many linguists.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **"Evolution."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wither **(मुरझाना): To become dry and shriveled.

 
 
• **Example:** The flowers will** wither** if they are not watered regularly.
 
 
 
• **Ennoblement **(अभिजात्य): The act of giving someone a noble rank or title.
 
 
• **Example: **His **ennoblement** by the king was a recognition of his services to the country.
 
 
 
• **Flourishing** (फूलना): Developing rapidly and successfully; thriving.
 
 
• **Example:** The company is** flourishing **under the new management.
